title: Over 100 Migrants Are Dead After Boat Capsizes Near Djibouti
summary_full: The shipwreck is among the deadliest ever recorded on the route to Yemen, the International Organization for Migration said. Dozens remain missing, and the bodies of 15 children were recovered.
